A.depoimento: Ordered the construction of two spearmen in Lisboa. Marched three spearmen and one archer to Santarem, and two archers to Evora, to seize the two neutral villages adjacent to our capital.
A.plano: Secure Santarem and Evora this turn to expand to 3 villages. Next turn, reinforce the new villages and push toward Coimbra and Badajoz to control the central road network. Aim to capture 12 villages by turn 5 and hold 18+ for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: I recruited two fresh spearmen and marched my entire army from Barcelona to seize the neutral village of Tarragona.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona this turn. Next turn, reinforce both Barcelona and Tarragona, then attack Girona to expand further. Keep building spearman for steady growth.

A.depoimento: We attacked Coimbra with Santarem's forces, held Santarem and Evora, and sent reinforcements from Lisboa to prepare for future offensives. Our army grows as we push toward the central territories.
A.plano: Secure Coimbra this turn, reinforce Santarem and Evora for next-turn pushes on Badajoz and Faro. Build spearman in Lisboa to increase numbers. Next turn, capture Badajoz and Faro, then expand along the central road network via Salamanca and Toledo to control the map and reach the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: This turn I built two spearmen in Barcelona and launched a coordinated assault: archers took Girona and Castellon, spearmen seized Zaragoza, while Barcelona's spearmen reinforced Tarragona. Our eastern front is now secured.
B.plano: Next turn, secure Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza by leaving garrisons and building more troops. Continue expanding west along the road network, prioritizing neutral villages with spearman garrisons. Do not divert forces to the enemy capital until we have a secure frontline.

A.depoimento: I reinforced Lisboa’s spearmen to Santarem and dispatched Evora’s knights to seize Faro, while raising fresh spearmen in all three home villages.
A.plano: Next turn, Santarem will field four spearmen to capture Badajoz. Simultaneously, we will hold Faro and prepare a push from Coimbra toward Salamanca and Toledo, securing the central corridor for a march on the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: Built four spearman in Barcelona and Tarragona. Sent two spearman from each to reinforce Girona and Castellon, strengthening our western front.
B.plano: Hold Girona and Castellon with fresh spearman, continue building spearman for future attacks. Do not launch offensives this turn; prepare to expand west once we have a stronger force.

A.depoimento:
Sent Santarem's six spearmen to attack Badajoz.
Built new spearmen in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, and Coimbra to reinforce our armies.
A.plano: Capture Badajoz with Santarem's spearmen next turn, then use it as a forward base to seize Toledo and Sevilha. Simultaneously, build up spearman forces in Coimbra and Lisboa to later take Porto and Salamanca, securing the central corridor for a march toward the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: We took Valencia with a mixed force from Castellon, sent spearmen to bolster Tarragona and Zaragoza, dispatched a knight to Castellon for upcoming operations, and increased our infantry production across the realm.
B.plano: Capture Valencia this turn to reach 6 villages. Reinforce Tarragona and Zaragoza with spearmen for future production. Send a knight to Castellon to prepare a Teruel attack. Build spearmen everywhere and an archer at Girona. Do not attack Huesca yet; wait for stronger force.

A.depoimento: We marched Coimbra's spearmen and archers to take Porto, and Evora's forces to seize Sevilha. Simultaneously, we ordered knight production in our heartland villages to prepare for a swift offensive against Toledo and Salamanca. Our holdings grow as we advance.
A.plano: Secure Porto and Sevilha this turn to expand to 8 villages. Build knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra for a rapid strike on Toledo and Salamanca next turn. Use captured forward bases to launch a push toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent 4 spearmen from Lisboa to take Porto and 2 knights from Lisboa to take Salamanca. I built new knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Coimbra, Faro and spearmen in Evora and Badajoz to reinforce my armies.
A.plano: Secure Porto and Salamanca this turn to reach 8 villages. Use captured bases to launch knights toward Toledo and spearmen toward Sevilha next turn. Build knights and spearmen in home villages to stockpile for future pushes.

A.depoimento: I sent a knight from Lisboa to capture Porto, while ordering new knights in Santarem, Evora, Badajoz and Faro and two spearmen in Coimbra to strengthen our interior.
A.plano: Secure Porto this turn to reach 9 villages. Next turn use Porto as a base to launch knights toward Toledo and spearmen toward Cordoba. Continue building knights in iron-rich villages and spearmen elsewhere to stockpile for future pushes.

B.depoimento: We marched Girona's archers toward Huesca, backed by fresh spearmen from Barcelona. Tarragona diverted its infantry to Zaragoza, and Castellon sent reinforcements to Valencia. Across our realms, we turned all spare wood into spearmen, preparing for the next wave of conquest.
B.plano: Build spearmen everywhere to stockpile forces. Send Girona's archers to take Huesca while reinforcing it with Barcelona's spearmen. Shift Tarragona's troops to Zaragoza and Castellon's to Valencia for upcoming offensives. Avoid premature attacks on Teruel/Madrid until we have sufficient numbers.

A.depoimento: This turn I marched all available troops from Porto to attack Vigo, aiming to seize the neutral village and expand my kingdom. Simultaneously I ordered new knights and spearmen to be produced in my towns to prepare for future offensives.
A.plano: Capture Vigo this turn to reach 10 villages. Next turn reinforce Porto and launch knights from Badajoz toward Toledo while sending spearmen from Sevilha toward Cordoba. Continue building knights in iron-rich villages and spearmen elsewhere to stockpile for pushes toward enemy capital.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen everywhere. Sent Girona's spearmen to attack Huesca. Moved Tarragona's spearmen to Zaragoza and Castellon's spearmen to Valencia to strengthen our central forces for upcoming operations.
B.plano: Stockpile spearmen in all villages. Use Girona's spearmen to take Huesca next turn. Shift Tarragona's and Castellon's spearmen to reinforce Zaragoza and Valencia for future offensives. Avoid building archers or knights this turn and delay attacks on Teruel/Madrid until we have more knights.

A.depoimento: This turn I dispatched two knight squadrons from Badajoz to Toledo and three from Santarem to Cordoba.\nI sent spearmen from Coimbra to bolster Porto's garrison.\nI also ordered new troop production in all my villages to replace losses and prepare for the next push.
A.plano: Consolidate hold on Vigo, reinforce Porto, and take Toledo and Cordoba next turn.\nContinue building knights in iron-rich villages (Lisboa, Evora, Faro, Salamanca, Sevilha) and spearmen elsewhere.\nAfter securing the central neutrals, advance toward Madrid and Burgos to open a path to the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen production in all my villages and sent forces to seize the four neutral territories: 16 spearmen to Teruel, 7 spearmen to Pamplona, 2 knights to Madrid, and 7 spearmen to Murcia. My homeland remains lightly defended but ready to reinforce.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen everywhere; keep minimal garrisons. Next turn, capture Teruel, Madrid, Murcia and prepare to take Pamplona. Use newly visible villages (Toledo, Salamanca, Burgos, Cordoba) as stepping stones. Avoid building archers or knights unless surplus resources allow.

A.depoimento: Built knights in iron-rich villages and spearmen elsewhere. Sent Faro's full force to seize Cordoba. Sent Coimbra's knights to Porto and Porto's spearmen to Vigo to strengthen our northern flank.
A.plano: Capture Cordoba this turn via Faro army. Reinforce Porto with knights from Coimbra and Vigo with spearmen from Porto. Next turn, take Teruel and Burgos, then advance on Madrid to open the path to Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn we ordered the construction of spearmen across our holdings to stockpile for upcoming offensives. Valencia's mixed army marched on Teruel to seize the neutral village, while Huesca dispatched its spearmen toward Pamplona. Reinforcements flowed from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona and Castellon toward our central hub, and Murcia prepared a push on Cordoba. We held our existing towns and readied the next wave of expansion.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to boost reserves. Send Valencia's force to capture Teruel this turn. Send Huesca's spearmen to reinforce Pamplona for next-turn attack. Redirect interior troops from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon to strengthen core and prepare future pushes. Avoid building archers/knights unless surplus resources allow.

A.depoimento:
This turn I massed archers across my realm for future spear counters, reinforced Porto with knights from Coimbra and Vigo with spearmen from Porto.
I launched a combined force from Faro and Toledo to seize Cordoba, sent a spear‑knight mix from Salamanca to take Madrid, and marched Vigo spearmen to Burgos to secure the northern flank.
A.plano: Turn 12: Capture Cordoba with Faro army and Toledo knights. Turn 13: Use newly built archers to take Teruel and Burgos. Turn 14: Secure Madrid, then push toward Barcelona via Zaragoza and Valencia.

B.depoimento: This turn I marched the full force from Teruel to take Toledo, while sending reinforcements from Zaragoza and Valencia to fortify Madrid and Teruel. I also pulled troops from Huesca and Castellon inward to bolster our interior reserves. Every village produced spearmen, swelling our ranks for the next push.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to stockpile forces. Attack Toledo with Teruel's full garrison to capture an enemy village. Reinforce Madrid and Teruel from interior troops to secure borders. Send Huesca and Castellon troops inward to strengthen Zaragoza and Valencia for future pushes. Avoid building archers/knights or launching other attacks this turn.

A.depoimento: This turn I seized Murcia and Burgos, reinforced Madrid with archers and knights, and ordered new archers in every productive village to prepare for the upcoming offensive.
A.plano: Turn 13: Build archers in all villages to stockpile. Turn 14: Launch massed archer assault on Toledo from Badajoz and Sevilla. Turn 15: After Toledo falls, advance toward Zaragoza via Madrid and Burgos, while securing Valencia corridor. Turn 16+: Push toward Barcelona, neutralizing enemy strongholds.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen everywhere, sent 4 spearmen from Zaragoza to take Pamplona, and pulled reinforcements from Teruel and Huesca to strengthen Zaragoza for next turn.
B.plano: Capture Pamplona with Zaragoza forces while reinforcing Zaragoza from Teruel and Huesca. Build spearmen in all villages to stockpile. Avoid other attacks and avoid building archers/knights this turn.

A.depoimento: This turn I built archers in every feasible village to stockpile for future offensives. I launched a coordinated archer wave from Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Faro, Porto, Sevilha, and Madrid to overwhelm Toledo. Simultaneously, I dispatched a knight detachment from Córdoba to seize Murcia.
A.plano: Turn 13-14: Secure Toledo and Murcia via concentrated archer and knight assaults. Turn 15: Reinforce captured villages, build archers, prepare push toward Zaragoza via Madrid and Burgos. Turn 16+: Advance on Valencia corridor, isolate enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in every village to increase reserves. Sent reinforcements from Huesca and Teruel to Zaragoza, and from Valencia to Murcia, while shifting troops from Girona to Barcelona and Barcelona to Tarragona. Held Toledo's forces ready for future action.
B.plano: Continue reinforcing Zaragoza and Murcia with spearmen. Stockpile spearmen in all villages for future offensives. Prepare to attack Cordoba once we have sufficient forces. Avoid diverting troops to other fronts or building archers/knights.

A.depoimento: Sent archer squads from Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra to Toledo; from Cordoba and Madrid to Murcia; from Burgos and Vigo to Pamplona. Ordered archer production in all villages to replace losses. Expect to hold three new villages next turn.
A.plano: Turn 14-15: Capture Toledo, Murcia, Pamplona via archer assaults. Turn 15-16: Garrison captured villages, rebuild archer forces, prepare push toward Zaragoza. Turn 16-18: Advance on Zaragoza and Valencia corridor to isolate enemy capital.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in all productive villages.\nSent reinforcements from Tarragona, Huesca, Teruel to Zaragoza and from Valencia to Murcia.\nHeld defenses and prepared for next turn.
B.plano:
Continue reinforcing Zaragoza and Murcia with spearmen.
Stockpile spearmen in all villages for future offensives.
Prepare to attack Cordoba once we have sufficient forces.
Avoid diverting troops to other fronts or building archers/knights.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered archer production in every available village to replenish our marching columns. Our existing archer waves are en route to Toledo and Pamplona, aiming to break enemy defenses next turn.
A.plano: Continue archer pressure on Toledo, Murcia, and Pamplona to weaken enemy garrisons. Capture these villages sequentially, then garrison them and rebuild archer forces. After securing the southern flank, prepare a coordinated push toward Zaragoza using massed archer units to counter enemy spearmen.

B.depoimento:
Built two spearmen in each village.
Sent reinforcements: 2 spearmen from Teruel to Toledo, 10 from Zaragoza and 2 from Huesca to Pamplona, 5 from Valencia and 6 from Castellon to Murcia.
Holding the line.
B.plano:
Continue reinforcing Zaragoza and Murcia with spearmen.
Stockpile spearmen in all villages for future offensives.
Prepare to attack Cordoba once we have sufficient forces.
Avoid diverting troops to other fronts or building archers/knights.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent Sevilha's army to take Toledo, Badajoz's force to strike Murcia, and Burgos's troops to capture Pamplona. I also ordered one archer to be built in each of my villages to replenish losses.
A.plano: Continue securing captured villages Toledo, Murcia, Pamplona. Garrison them with surviving troops and rebuild archer forces in all holdings. Next turn, prepare a massed archer push from Badajoz and Sevilha toward Zaragoza to exploit archer advantage over enemy spearmen, while reinforcing the southern flank against any counterattacks.

B.depoimento: This turn we ordered the construction of one knight in each of our villages to stockpile elite troops. We also sent twenty spearmen from Zaragoza to capture Madrid, aiming to expand our territory.
B.plano: Continue reinforcing Madrid with troops to secure it. Build additional knights and spearmen in all villages for future offensives. Prepare to attack Cordoba and Burgos from Madrid next turn. Avoid spreading forces thin until we have a secure foothold.

A.depoimento: This turn I massed reinforcements: sent archers and knights to bolster Madrid and Burgos, launched a strike force from Toledo toward Teruel, and funneled supplies from Salamanca, Porto, and Vigo to strengthen our fronts. The tide is turning.
A.plano: Capture Teruel this turn with archers from Toledo. Reinforce Madrid and Burgos with archers and knights from Salamanca, Porto, and Vigo. Next turn, attack Zaragoza and Pamplona with combined forces. After securing those, move on to Huesca via Zaragoza/Pamplona.

B.depoimento:
Ordered a knight from Pamplona to march on Burgos, hoping to take the village.
Directed all villages to produce knights for upcoming offensives.
B.plano:
Capture Burgos by sending Pamplona's knight next turn.
Build a knight in every village to strengthen future attacks on Madrid and other fronts.
Avoid splitting forces; keep garrisons decent after the move.

A.depoimento: We struck at Zaragoza and Pamplona with archers and knights, while building archers across our lands to prepare for the next push.
A.plano: Capture Zaragoza and Pamplona this turn. Reinforce them next turn and attack Valencia and Castellon. Then advance toward Huesca and the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Ordered knight construction across most of our lands and sent two knights from Valencia to seize Teruel.
B.plano: Build knights in all villages except Pamplona to boost future attack force. Capture Teruel with 2 knights from Valencia to gain a village. Keep garrisons strong with remaining spearmen.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent Teruel's three archers to seize Valencia. I marched Toledo's nine spearmen to Teruel to prepare for next turn's offensive, and ordered two spearmen built at Teruel. We now threaten the enemy's eastern flank.
A.plano: Capture Valencia this turn. Reinforce Teruel with spearmen from Toledo and build spearmen there. Next turn attack Castellon (or Huesca) from Teruel. Then hold both and advance toward Huesca and the enemy capital.

B.depoimento:
I forged a knight in Valencia and an archer in Murcia.
Then I dispatched two knights from Zaragoza to seize Teruel.
We aim to expand our holdings and push toward victory.
B.plano:
Capture Teruel with the two knights from Zaragoza.
Next turn, reinforce Zaragoza if needed.
Continue building knights in Valencia and archers in Murcia to prepare for further offensives.

A.depoimento: Sent 9 archers from Toledo to capture Zaragoza, securing our 18th village. Built 4 spearmen in Toledo and 2 spearmen in Teruel to replenish our forces. No enemy armies were sighted this turn.
A.plano: Hold Zaragoza and reinforce it with spearmen from Toledo. Next turn, prepare to attack Huesca from Valencia or Pamplona while securing the Murcia front. After Huesca falls, advance toward Tarragona and the enemy capital Barcelona.

A.depoimento: This turn I built archers in Madrid, Valencia, Pamplona, Cordoba and Teruel to strengthen the front. I dispatched Madrid's six archers to join the Toledo archers en route to Zaragoza, aiming to capture the city next turn.
A.plano: Hold Zaragoza after capture; reinforce with spearmen from Toledo and archers from Madrid, Valencia, Pamplona. Next turn prepare to take Huesca from Valencia/Pamplona while securing Murcia front. After Huesca falls, advance toward Tarragona and enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Today we trained new archers and spearmen across our realms, while dispatching seasoned knights from Castellon and Murcia to seize the weakly held Valencia. Simultaneously, we sent spearmen from Tarragona and knights from Huesca to bolster Zaragoza’s defenses against the approaching enemy host.
B.plano: Next turn, capture Valencia will give us a forward base to launch archer attacks on Teruel. Continue building archers and spearmen to strengthen defenses. Keep Zaragoza reinforced against the incoming enemy army. Prepare to press forward once Teruel falls.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered the spearmen and archers from Teruel to march on Valencia, aiming to take the weakly defended enemy village. Simultaneously I directed Toledo to train spearmen and Madrid to train archers for next turn's assault on Zaragoza.
A.plano: Capture Valencia this turn using Teruel's spearmen and archers. Next turn seize Zaragoza with archers from Madrid. Then hold both and advance toward Huesca and Castellon, preparing to push toward Tarragona and the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: We sent a force of three knights to capture Madrid, while funneling archers from Murcia and Castellon to Valencia to prepare for a Teruel offensive. Spearmen from Barcelona and Tarragona are marching to bolster Zaragoza's defenses, and we built additional troops across our realms to ready for the next push.
B.plano: Next turn, we will have Madrid under our control, giving us a forward base. We will continue to stockpile archers in Valencia for a strike on Teruel, and reinforce Zaragoza with incoming spearmen. We will also train more knights in Girona and Valencia for future assaults on Pamplona and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: I ordered Pamplona's archers and knight to march on Huesca, aiming to add an eighteenth village to our realm. Meanwhile, every village began forging fresh knights to strengthen our future armies.
A.plano: Next turn seize Huesca with Pamplona's archers and knight. Following turn, reinforce Huesca and take Zaragoza with Madrid's archers. Then hold both and advance toward Castellon and Tarragona, preparing to push toward the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I launched assaults on Valencia and Teruel, capturing both. I ordered the production of knights and spears across my realms to strengthen my army. My troops march onward, and the tide begins to turn.
B.plano: Next turn we will hold Valencia and Teruel. We will garrison them with fresh spears and begin training knights in Girona and Barcelona for future strikes on Pamplona and Cordoba. Reinforce Zaragoza with the incoming spearmen. We will not attack Madrid or Pamplona this turn due to archer counter disadvantage.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of spearmen in Toledo, Cordoba, Madrid, and Huesca to strengthen our defenses. I sent a force of 7 spearmen and 1 knight from Toledo to take Teruel, and 6 archers with 2 knights from Cordoba to seize Murcia. If victorious, we will control 18 villages.
A.plano: Capture Teruel and Murcia to reach 18 held villages. Reinforce Toledo, Cordoba, Madrid, and Huesca with spearmen for defense. Hold the line and prepare to defend against enemy counterattacks next turn. If successful, maintain control for a second turn to win.

B.depoimento: We launched a bold strike from Girona against Huesca, sending 1 spear and 7 knights while keeping Girona fortified. Simultaneously, we ordered spearmen production in all our holdings and a knight in Teruel to boost our army. This turn we secured our borders and prepared for the next offensive.
B.plano: Hold Girona with at least 7 spears to defend against Huesca. Build spears everywhere and a knight in Teruel for future attacks. Avoid attacking Pamplona this turn to keep Zaragoza defended. Next turn reinforce Zaragoza and prepare strikes on Toledo and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: I focused on strengthening our forces: trained two archers in Madrid and eight spearmen in Pamplona, preparing to strike Zaragoza and Huesca next turn.
A.plano: Build 2 archers at Madrid and 8 spearmen at Pamplona this turn. Next turn, send Madrid's archers+spearmen to take Zaragoza and Pamplona's spearmen to take Huesca, reaching 18 held villages. Then defend the new borders and hold for a second turn to win.

B.depoimento: I ordered spear construction across my realms to strengthen our hold. A knight force marched from Huesca to seize Pamplona. We aim to secure the village and prepare for next turn's expansion.
B.plano: Build spears in all villages to raise defenses. Send 3 knights from Huesca to capture Pamplona. Keep at least 2 knights and 1 spear in Huesca for defense. Avoid other attacks this turn to concentrate forces.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent Faro's archers and knights to seize Teruel and Huesca, bringing our total to 18 villages. We now aim to hold them and secure victory.
A.plano: Capture Teruel and Huesca to reach 18 held villages. Next turn, defend these new borders and reinforce them to hold for a second consecutive turn to win.

B.depoimento: Ordered spearmen production in all villages to strengthen defenses. Sent 14 spearmen from Valencia to seize Toledo.
B.plano: Capture Toledo to reach 9 held villages. Keep sufficient garrisons after sending troops. Avoid attacking Pamplona this turn due to lack of archers and previous defeat.

A.depoimento: Sent reinforcements to Madrid and Toledo, bolstered defenses, and built archers and knights across the realm. Our forces march toward Teruel while we prepare a strike on Zaragoza.
A.plano: Hold Toledo, reinforce Madrid via Salamanca and Burgos for a Zaragoza strike next turn while Teruel assault arrives. After securing Zaragoza and Teruel, defend new borders and aim for 18 villages.

B.depoimento: Built archers in most villages and knights in Barcelona and Tarragona. Sent reinforcements from Zaragoza, Castellon, and Valencia to Teruel to bolster defenses; kept home garrisons.
B.plano: Capture Toledo next turn with marching spearmen. Reinforce Teruel with 22 spearmen and 2 archers to defend against two enemy armies; build archers everywhere and knights in Barcelona/Tarragona; keep home garrisons; avoid attacking Pamplona or Madrid this turn.

A.depoimento: Sent most troops from Madrid to Zaragoza and from Murcia to Valencia, leaving small garrisons. Expect to seize both enemy villages and raise our held villages to 18. Hold the line and prepare for next pushes.
A.plano: Capture Zaragoza and Valencia this turn to reach 18 villages. Then reinforce new borders and defend against enemy counterattacks. After securing the east, advance toward Teruel and Huesca to consolidate control.

B.depoimento: This turn I built archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Valencia, Huesca, and Teruel. I sent Castellon's troops to Valencia, Girona's to Huesca, and Huesca and Tarragona's troops to Zaragoza to strengthen our borders. My armies march toward Teruel as scheduled.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Valencia and Zaragoza to prepare attack on Murcia. Reinforce Valencia with Castellon troops and Zaragoza with Huesca/Tarragona troops. Keep Teruel defended with existing marches. Do not split forces; focus on building a strong striking force in Valencia for next turn.

A.depoimento: Reinforced Zaragoza with 2 spearmen from Toledo and Pamplona with 3 troops from Burgos and 1 from Zaragoza. Held troops in Murcia for future counterattack. Ordered spearman production in key interior villages to strengthen economy and readiness for next turn.
A.plano: Hold Toledo, Zaragoza, Pamplona; reinforce them to withstand Teruel and Tarragona threats. Accept possible loss of Valencia; prepare to retake Huesca next turn from Zaragoza. Build spearmen in interior villages to boost future production and defense.

B.depoimento: Built a knight in Barcelona and spearmen in Tarragona, Castellon, Huesca, and Teruel, plus archers in Girona. Sent five archers from Teruel to seize Valencia.
B.plano: Capture Valencia with archers from Teruel to reach 7 villages. Keep at least 20 troops in Teruel to defend against Zaragoza. Build a knight in Barcelona for fast offense and spearmen in border villages for defense. Do not attack stronger targets like Toledo or Zaragoza now.
